description: This Java class defines an email template utility for generating email data maps for different account-related notifications. It provides static methods to create templates for account creation, deletion, and password change events, using constants for message texts and sender name.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to generate email templates for account-related notifications.

methods.name: getAccountCreatedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Creates an email template map for account creation notification, including recipient name and message text.

methods.name: getAccountDeletedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Creates an email template map for account deletion notification, including recipient name and message text.

methods.name: getChangePasswordEmailTemplate
methods.description: Creates an email template map for password change notification, including recipient name and message text.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Private helper method that initializes a map with recipient and sender names.
